messages.content: Find a picnic spot in Miami.

function.name: local_fauna
function.description: Get information about fauna in a specified region. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The region or area to find information about.

species_type.description: Type of species e.g birds, mammals etc. for detailed information.

migration_season.description: Season when fauna migrate e.g spring, winter, none. Default is none.

message.content:
Here are a few great picnic spots in Miami where you can relax, enjoy the scenery, and have a nice meal outdoors: | Spot | Description | Highlights | |------|-------------|------------| | **South Pointe Park** | Located at the southern tip of Miami Beach, this park offers panoramic views of the ocean, cruise ships, and the Miami skyline. | • Picnic tables with ocean views
• Walking paths and a playground
• Nearby restaurants and cafés | | **Bill Baggs Cape Florida State Park** | A historic park on Key Biscayne featuring a beautiful lighthouse and sandy beaches. | • Picnic areas with grills
• Lighthouse tours
• Kayaking and paddleboarding | | **Lummus Park** | A beachfront park on Ocean Drive, perfect for a casual beach picnic. | • Open grassy areas
• Volleyball courts
• Easy access to the beach | | **Venetian Pool** | A historic public pool built from a coral rock quarry, surrounded by lush landscaping. | • Picnic tables around the pool
• Swimming and water slides
• Great for families | | **Oleta River State Park** | The largest urban park in Florida, offering a mix of nature trails and water activities. | • Picnic shelters and grills
• Canoe rentals
• Wildlife viewing | | **Miami Beach Boardwalk** | Stretching along the Atlantic, this boardwalk is ideal for a scenic picnic with a view of the waves. | • Picnic benches and shaded areas
• Nearby cafés and ice cream shops
• Sunset views | **Tips for a successful picnic:** - Check the weather forecast and bring sunscreen, hats, and plenty of water. - If you’re planning to use a grill, confirm whether it’s allowed and if you need a permit. - Bring a blanket or portable chairs for extra comfort. - Pack a cooler with snacks, drinks, and a trash bag to keep the area clean. Enjoy your time in Miami!
